name: Navis-Launch-Film
description: NavisLabs launch film (Remotion). V8 final-audio candidate: founder voice (public/voiceover/final/v6, locked) · founder-supplied Eleven Music track (public/music/final/v8) · SFX + room tone temp (in-project) · copy: src/data/navislabs_v8_copy.json · data: src/data/navislabs_v8_launch_state.json

scripts.audio:temp: python3 scripts/make-score-v7.py && python3 scripts/make-sfx-v7.py && python3 scripts/make-room-v8.py
scripts.data:build: python3 scripts/analyze-voice.py && python3 scripts/build-film-data-v8.py && python3 scripts/build-audits.py && python3 scripts/build-captions.py && python3 scripts/build-v8-audio.py
scripts.render:review: remotion render NavisLaunch out/navislabs-final-audio-review-1080p.raw.mp4 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 --crf=16 --color-space=bt709 --audio-bitrate=320k && python3 scripts/master-audio.py out/navislabs-final-audio-review-1080p.raw.mp4 out/navislabs-final-audio-review-1080p.mp4 out/navislabs-final-audio-review-540p.mp4
scripts.check:render: python3 scripts/check-render.py out/navislabs-final-audio-review-1080p.mp4 navislabs_v8_render_check.json && python3 scripts/check-render.py out/navislabs-final-audio-review-540p.mp4 navislabs_v8_render_check_540p.json && python3 scripts/blur-scan.py out/navislabs-final-audio-review-1080p.mp4 navislabs_v8_blur_scan.json
scripts.render:stems: for st in voice music sfx room; do remotion render NavisLaunch out/stems/v8-$st.wav --codec=wav --props="{\"endingVariant\":\"A\",\"useAlternates\":[],\"mode\":\"preview\",\"stem\":\"$st\"}"; done
